newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent climbs slightly, gas oil holds lower.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent climbs slightly, gas oil holds lower.

text.p: IPE Brent futures partially reversed Wednesday's fall in early trade on Thursday, while gas oil headed downwards to catch up with Brent, brokers said.
They said the market lacked direction and would likely await the NYMEX open. "It's anybody's guess where it goes from here," one commented.
January Brent built slightly on its initial gains and was trading up 39 cents at $22.93 a barrel at 1250 GMT. Brokers said they doubted whether it would breach $23.00 in the afternoon.
December gas oil was down $4.25 at $219.50 a tonne, reversing its $2 gain on Wednesday.
Cold weather had helped drive up gas oil over the past few days. Brokers said the arctic cold front pushing across the United States could push NYMEX higher at the open.
The market continued to watch the outcome of the dispute between AIC and Cargill in which the former accused the latter of failing to lift the required volume in the first five day period.
Cargill in London declined to comment on the AIC statement.
